staged.session_check: guest reached through the detached session

reboot.note: The worker stayed off the network (Tailscale offline) from the reboot until a console login; FileVault keeps the disk locked, so no user-session network or SSH is available before that.

cases.detail: the per-user service is not loaded at boot; the first SSH control connection started it (service.log 2026-10-11T14:07:24Z) with a new epoch
host vm inspect after reboot: reboot-check stopped (generation 2); reconciliation observed it stopped at 14:07:25Z
the client coordinator removed the detached session's ssh_config after its lease lapsed; the session was issued under epoch d07bcacf, and access sessions are volatile, so none survive the new epoch

a saved copy of a live detached session's ssh config and descriptor (epoch 50bf423d...) connected before a service restart; after launchctl kickstart -k of the host service the same copy was refused by the host: 'relay refused: SESSION_EXPIRED: daemon epoch changed; open a new session after a fresh hello'. A new session reached the guest.
